findings.summary: The component still contains its own trigger branch even though the shell owns the only current trigger.
findings.consequence: Quick Search has two trigger implementations that can drift in keyboard behavior, labels, and modal-open body handling, while the internal one is not reached by the current source usage.
findings.evidence: The owned template renders an internal trigger starting at line 388 behind `v-if="!initiallyOpen"`. Source search found the only current component mount in `app/components/global/SiteShell.vue` as `<LazyQuickSearch initially-open @closed="closeQuickSearch" />`, with the visible trigger implemented separately in the shell. The SSR test also asserts the shell trigger, not this branch.
findings.recommendation: Remove the internal trigger branch and make QuickSearch a dialog-only component opened by its parent; then drop the `initiallyOpen` prop default path and keep trigger semantics in SiteShell.
